rationale: C21 is a direct drafting template for the child: both are memoranda to the same addressees concerning the nationwide fall Community Chest and United Fund campaigns, and they share the same sequence—describe the campaign and aggregate goals, assure federal cooperation, request departmental cooperation across the United States and its territories and possessions, prescribe equitable goals/employee solicitation/installment collection, and encourage generous giving. C14 and C03 contain closely parallel campaign machinery and substantial shared language, but are narrower National Capital Area versions.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This fall Community Chests and United Funds all over the country will conduct their annual campaigns... The goals of these campaigns will aggregate over $290,000,000.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Community Chests and United Funds all over the country will conduct their annual campaigns this fall... The goals of these campaigns will aggregate over $280,000,000.
shared_material.explanation: The opening premise, nationwide campaign framing, timing, and aggregate-goal presentation are nearly identical, with updated figures and beneficiaries.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I have assured the leaders of United Community Campaigns of America... of the cooperation of the Federal Government.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I have assured the leaders of United Community Campaigns of the cooperation of the Federal government in their endeavors.
shared_material.explanation: This is distinctive shared language expressing the same presidential assurance to the same campaign organization.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am confident that you will extend the full cooperation of your Department in each community throughout the United States and its territories and possessions where it conducts its operations.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am confident that you will extend the full cooperation of your department in each community throughout the United States and its territories and possessions where it conducts its operations.
shared_material.explanation: The operative request is essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Such cooperation should include the effective solicitation of all employees, the acceptance of equitable unit goals and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Such cooperation would logically include the assumption of equitable unit goals, the effective solicitation of all employees and the setting up of an adequate collection method for the convenience of those who wish to make contributions on an installment basis.
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the same three-part administrative machinery with only minor changes in wording and order.

shared_material.child_excerpt: It is my hope that all employees will give generously... keeping in mind the wide variety and large number of organizations they will be supporting through their gifts to this single appeal.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It is my hope that all employees will give generously keeping in mind the fact that their gifts will be used to support a number of different organizations for a full year.
shared_material.explanation: Both close with the same appeal for generous employee giving justified by the multiple organizations supported through the consolidated campaign.
